wire_artifact.summary: Validity must include expiration before either reader uses an entry.

evidence: The user requires expiration handling and fresh-read preservation.

existing_contract: Only current entries may be returned.

high_level_approach: Enforce expiration in the shared validity predicate and verify both readers.

technical_acceptance: Expired entries cannot be returned or reported readable.

in_scope_consumers.name: Value reader
in_scope_consumers.why_affected: read_value branches on is_current before returning a value.
in_scope_consumers.required_behavior: Expired values are not returned; fresh values are returned.
evidence: reader_a.py imports is_current and uses it in read_value.

required_proof.claim: Expired values are not returned; fresh values are returned.

in_scope_consumers.name: Availability reader
in_scope_consumers.why_affected: can_read branches on is_current before reporting availability.
in_scope_consumers.required_behavior: Expired entries are unavailable; fresh entries are available.
evidence: reader_b.py imports is_current and uses it in can_read.

required_proof.claim: Expired entries are unavailable; fresh entries are available.

not_affected_consumers.name: Display title
not_affected_consumers.reason: title returns static text without reading validity or entries.
evidence: sibling.py title has no parameters and returns a literal.

related_out_of_scope.name: Empty count ratio
related_out_of_scope.relation: The reporting sibling also processes entry counts.
related_out_of_scope.reason: Zero division is independent of expiration and does not affect either reader.
evidence: metrics.py ratio divides by total without a zero guard.
related_out_of_scope.suggested_follow_up: Define and test ratio behavior for an empty count.

search_evidence.method: Trace predicate imports, entry fields and sibling entry consumers.
search_evidence.conclusion: Both decision points use the predicate; static title and count ratio are independent.

impact_closure.closure_summary: The shared predicate, both decision points and plausible siblings were inspected and classified; entries are supplied by callers.

preservation.claim: Both readers accept active fresh entries.

consumers.claim: Expired values are not returned; fresh values are returned.
Expired entries are unavailable; fresh entries are available.
